context: Takeda discusses traffic-control plans with Ren as a volunteer.

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: レン君、当日の動き、確認しよう。
lines.en: Ren-kun, let's go over how things went that day.
lines.style: Even, measured cadence. Professional but not cold — the tone of someone who trusts the person across from him. Slight nod embedded in the voice. Steady eye contact built into every word.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい、どこに、立てばいいですか？
lines.style: Quick intake of breath. Eager to get it right, slightly deferential without being timid. Words land softly but with intention. A young person showing up for something that matters.

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.en: At the station front. Watch the flow of people.
lines.style: Clear, directive. Each phrase gets its own small weight — not rushed, not repetitive. The voice of someone used to being listened to, giving guidance that assumes competence.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 了解。安全な行動、心がけます。
lines.en: Understood. I'll make sure to keep safety in mind.
lines.style: Formal politeness that still has genuine warmth underneath. Each word deliberate. A quiet commitment — not over-promising, just steady affirmation.

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: 皆と、一緒に、お願いします。
lines.en: Please work together with everyone on this.
lines.style: Slight softening compared to the earlier directives. Still measured, but there's a collaborative undertone now — less commanding, more 'we're in this together.' Final phrase lands with quiet trust.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 頑張ります、無事に、終わるように。
lines.en: I'll do my best to make sure everything goes safely.
lines.style: Forward-leaning energy. No hesitation, but not rushed either. Earnest without being performative. The voice of someone who's understood the weight of what's being asked and accepted it.

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.style: Brief, spare. Complete sentence of meaning in a few words. Warm enough to feel genuine, formal enough to carry its own authority. Ends on a note of trust, not dismissal.
